description: Plants a fault: the world's own style prompt demands a status bar in a fenced block after every reply, which the program must keep out of the narration.

add.prompts/en/roleplay/style.md:
Write in plain, concrete prose. Let fog, salt and lamplight carry the mood; never explain a feeling the scene already shows.

End every reply with a status line in a fenced block, for example:
```
HP: 12 | Gold: 40 | Time: 18:30
```
